content.title: KITCHEN CURES FOR {{ANNOYING}} PROBLEMS
facts: Bloating ----- Peppermint Tea: contains **menthol** that relaxes gut muscles and helps release trapped gas.
Muscle Cramps ----- Bananas: rich in **potassium**, a mineral essential for proper muscle contraction.
Headaches ----- Watermelon: mostly water content, helps fight **dehydration**, a common headache trigger.
Bad Breath ----- Apples: crunchy texture and **fiber** help naturally scrub away odor-causing bacteria.
Hiccups ----- Peanut Butter: its thick texture forces **slow, deliberate swallowing** that can reset the diaphragm.
Brain Fog ----- Blueberries: loaded with **antioxidants** linked to sharper focus and mental clarity.
Sore Throat ----- Honey: offers natural **antibacterial** properties that help soothe irritation.
